headerBefore.layout: header|segment(chunk-lines then entry-lines), repeated; appended segments start at EOF
headerBefore.note: Chunk indices 76..84 belong to the second pack and are offset by 76. Chunk 75 is the first pack's tail and is therefore a short non-final chunk; every other non-final chunk is exactly chunkBytes. Entry history.jsonl was renamed to history.jsonl.old to match the surviving name.

notes: candidate index 0..N-1 is the file order of chunk lines with the duplicated id
conventionalLastCandidate mirrors work/restore-history.ps1 behaviour (last chunk line wins for a duplicated id)
chosen.candidateLineOffs are absolute byte offsets of the winning chunk line; stable under append-only growth
